integrity_caveats: Urban path: market value is the data-zone median house price (an improved dwelling), shrunk when the sales count is thin. A suppressed cell is missing, not zero. The council median is the comparison and the fallback. Site capital = max(0, MV − DRC). The 85% ceiling is a bound, not an estimate. The 15% floor is a sensitivity only.
Economic rent base applies Pickard factors to residual site capital, then × 5% yield for annual AGR. Effective rate = Pickard factor × yield. Neither factor is calibrated to the Sandilands pool.
HABU policy = existing authorised use; hope value excluded from assessment basis. The house price is still an improved-dwelling sale, not a full planning strip.

Spatial grain for urban market value is the 2011 data zone, then the intermediate zone, then the council. It is not a finished national roll and not a fitted model. Rural rent is one category rate for the whole of Scotland.
Rural path uses productive land-use capital (Pickard 5× farmland market distortion), not farm-sale residual.
The Sandilands national rent pool (£90bn) is separate; map roll cells are not calibrated to sum to that pool.
Non-domestic, vacant, and natural-resource rents (Sandilands classical Land) are not yet on this roll.
Not a substitute for a VOA/ROS professional valuation or a statutory AGR roll.

integrity_caveats: Urban path: market value is the data-zone median house price (an improved dwelling), shrunk when the sales count is thin. A suppressed cell is missing, not zero. The council median is the comparison and the fallback. Site capital = max(0, MV − DRC). The 85% ceiling is a bound, not an estimate. The 15% floor is a sensitivity only.
Economic rent base applies Pickard factors to residual site capital, then × 5% yield for annual AGR. Effective rate = Pickard factor × yield. Neither factor is calibrated to the Sandilands pool.
HABU policy = existing authorised use; hope value excluded from assessment basis. The house price is still an improved-dwelling sale, not a full planning strip.

Spatial grain for urban market value is the 2011 data zone, then the intermediate zone, then the council. It is not a finished national roll and not a fitted model. Rural rent is one category rate for the whole of Scotland.
Rural path uses productive land-use capital (Pickard 5× farmland market distortion), not farm-sale residual.
The Sandilands national rent pool (£90bn) is separate; map roll cells are not calibrated to sum to that pool.
Non-domestic, vacant, and natural-resource rents (Sandilands classical Land) are not yet on this roll.
Not a substitute for a VOA/ROS professional valuation or a statutory AGR roll.
